info.title: Dar El Barka API
info.description: Contract of the `/api/v1` prefix. Every response is an envelope `{ data, meta }`; every error is `{ error: { code, message, fieldErrors?, correlationId } }`. Collections are paginated pages; statements are cursor-paged with balances in `meta`.

get.summary: Operational summary, one block per permission held
Revenue, sales, expenses and margin of a period, with the trend
Sales and order pickups by weekday and hour
Products sold over a period, categories and unsold products
Customer segments, best customers and customers to win back (also needs customers.view)
Permission catalogue, flat and grouped by module
Roles with permission and user counts

Statement.description: A cursor-paged ledger statement. `items` are the entries of the page; `meta` carries the balances of the window and the cursor of the next page.
